content:
The Dallas Cowboys got back on track in a big way on Monday Night Football, beating the Philadelphia Eagles 38-21 at Lincoln Financial Field to snap a two-game losing streak.

Dallas pulled away after a back-and-forth night that featured six lead changes. The Cowboys took the lead for good late in the third quarter on CeeDee Lamb's 16-yard touchdown reception and Dak Prescott's two-point conversion, then scored 18 unanswered points to close out the win. By quarter, Dallas outscored Philadelphia 10-10-8-10, while the Eagles were held scoreless in the fourth quarter.

Prescott finished 15-of-27 for 212 yards and three touchdowns with no interceptions — two touchdown passes to Lamb and one to George Pickens. Lamb caught five passes for 74 yards and two scores, and Pickens added four catches for 57 yards and a touchdown. Javonte Williams powered the ground game with a career-high 155 rushing yards and a touchdown on 25 carries, and Dallas ran for 204 yards as a team.

Philadelphia, playing without quarterback Jalen Hurts, who is out for the season with blood clots, started Tanner McKee for the second straight week. McKee went 23-of-35 for 211 yards with one touchdown and one interception. Saquon Barkley, back after missing two games with a hamstring injury, carried seven times for 62 yards and a touchdown.

With the win, Dallas improves to 3-4 on the season. Philadelphia falls to 2-5, its fifth straight loss.

The Cowboys return home next Sunday, November 1, to host the Arizona Cardinals at AT&T Stadium, with kickoff set for 12:00 p.m. CT.

Sources: NBC Sports; Reuters; USA Today.

title: Cowboys Run Past Eagles 38-21 on Monday Night Football
